meta.name: consultant
meta.description: Think and deliver like a management consultant from McKinsey, BCG, or Bain. Use when the user wants to: (1) Structure a business problem with hypothesis-driven decomposition, (2) Run strategy analysis with professional frameworks — market sizing, competitive landscape, financial modeling, SWOT, Porter's, (3) Build MBB-quality deliverables — executive summaries, strategy deck outlines, decision memos, (4) Apply firm-specific methodology — McKinsey verdict-first, BCG framework-first, or Bain decision-first, (5) Package analysis for non-consulting audiences — investor pitches, board presentations, conference talks. Produces structured analysis and deliverable CONTENT. For visual production, hand off to a delivery skill for slides, documents, or spreadsheets.
